scope: 30 ordinary/30 changed T11 criteria and exact carry correction; no historical evidence rewritten

criteria.task: Classify five original components: hosted allocation-free parser, freestanding byte routine, no-libc Linux syscall image, custom-entry image with explicit compiler runtime, and a library using caller-provided allocation callbacks. Write separate yes/no/unknown claims for hosted, freestanding, libc-free, allocation-free and custom-startup.

ordinary_observation.claim: Five environment/profile claims are assessed independently against actual parser/byte/raw/runtime/callback specimens

transfer_observation.claim: Allocating callback changes allocation-free claim without introducing a direct malloc symbol in component

criteria.task: Draw a dependency boundary around the byte library and separately around its hosted differential-test executable. List permitted imports at each boundary and show why the host oracle's memmove is not a target implementation dependency.

ordinary_observation.claim: Hosted oracle and restricted archive/image have separately recorded dependencies

transfer_observation.claim: Same original byte primitive executes inside strict no-library native and M4 closures

criteria.task: Produce a manifest of source headers, unresolved helpers, linked objects, dynamic libraries, syscalls, callbacks and storage acquisition for the actual component. Include one hidden compiler-emitted dependency and one explicit callback.

ordinary_observation.claim: Headers, object helpers, final origins, syscalls, storage and callback ownership are distinct manifest fields

transfer_observation.claim: Actual producer callback contract is bound and executed; unknown callbacks remain conditional

criteria.task: Compile an original aggregate-copy probe under hosted, -ffreestanding and -fno-builtin controls, then link under separately varied exclusions. Record __STDC_HOSTED__, effective commands and symbols at each stage.

ordinary_observation.claim: Hosted/freestanding/fno-builtin compilation separated from actual link closure

transfer_observation.claim: O0/O2/Os/LTO final images are separately executed and inspected

criteria.task: Use a minimal original entry and a hosted main in a matrix of -nostartfiles, -nodefaultlibs and -nostdlib. Attribute every success/failure to retained startup or library inputs using driver output, not only error text.

ordinary_observation.claim: Three driver exclusions have distinct measured CRT/libc inputs and intended outcomes

transfer_observation.claim: Original byte provider resolves nostdlib image without library imports

criteria.task: Compare allowed header search with a deliberately restricted -nostdinc configuration using a local minimal include directory. Separate failure to find a declaration from failure to supply a linked implementation.

ordinary_observation.claim: Missing declaration fails independently from available linked implementation

transfer_observation.claim: Restricted target type manifest rejects deliberately leaked LP64 uint32 header

criteria.task: Compile original fixed-size copies, zero-initializations and comparisons at several sizes; inspect object relocations and calls for memcpy/memmove/memset/memcmp or other actual support. Record observed absence as profile-specific.

ordinary_observation.claim: Fixed1/3/16/128/257 copy/compare and64-byte copy/zero plus bounded runtime copy lowerings inspected per compiler

transfer_observation.claim: Aligned32-byte preconditions are executed separately and actual final disassembly retained

criteria.task: Use a64-byte aggregate assignment and zero initialization under O0/O2/Os plus supported LTO. Compare semantic output with a byte oracle and inspect final code even when intermediate LTO objects hide ordinary machine code.

ordinary_observation.claim: 64-byte copy/zero passes independent byte-pattern oracle under O0/O2/Os/LTO

transfer_observation.claim: Every runtime-selected length0..64 executes and final helper closure remains explicit

criteria.task: Provide a documented local byte-support implementation required by a chosen compiler, with exact symbol signature, permitted overlap and zero-length behavior. Confirm calling convention and prevent fallback to the hosted C library.

ordinary_observation.claim: Exact standard byte signatures use original provider and no target libc

transfer_observation.claim: Duplicate provider is rejected by the actual linker

criteria.task: For variable unsigned128 division, wide multiplication and floating/integer conversion probes inspect emitted support on x86-64 and one available constrained compile target. Keep unsupported profiles explicit and do not execute out-of-range conversion as defined.

ordinary_observation.claim: Variable128-bit x86 and64-bit Arm division/multiplication/conversion objects inspected

transfer_observation.claim: Signed helper lowering observed; signed-min/-1 is excluded from defined execution

criteria.task: Select one observed compiler-rt/libgcc helper, inspect its target-specific declaration/implementation contract, and compare argument/result ABI and exceptional inputs with the learner primitive. Record unavailable source as a gap rather than inventing equivalence.

ordinary_observation.claim: Selected LLVM21.1.8 helper declaration/type and nonzero contract bind the actual native call ABI

transfer_observation.claim: Original Arm r0/r1 quotient plus r2/r3 remainder adapter executes256 independent64-bit vectors per guest

criteria.task: Derive the exact128-step quotient/remainder invariant for the existing mi_divide contract and prove whether a high carry can occur. Then implement fr_divmod128 and the full-width streaming fr_divstep128 extension. Compare original local, declared compiler-runtime and explicit unsupported policies with code/stack/operation/time evidence under equal contracts where possible.

ordinary_observation.claim: Versioned carry correction distinguishes ordinary128-step invariant from streaming129th-bit extension; actual mi_divide imported

transfer_observation.claim: Independent unbounded quotient/remainder reconstruction and original limb implementation execute

criteria.task: Compile correctly aligned atomic operations at several supported widths, record lock-free queries/macros and inspect out-of-line support. Never form a deliberately misaligned atomic object to obtain a timing result.

ordinary_observation.claim: Aligned atomics at1/4/8/16 bytes have actual lock-free queries and emitted-import evidence

transfer_observation.claim: Out-of-line helper lacks an interrupt-safe latency/reentrancy contract; reject ISR use rather than infer it from _Atomic

criteria.task: Compare stack protection, ASan/UBSan, profiling and coverage on the same original component; enumerate emitted symbols, startup requirements and extra storage. Use positive controls proving instrumentation is present.

ordinary_observation.claim: Five instrumentation modes have final markers, runtime origins and applicable executed controls

transfer_observation.claim: All five modes repeat with LTO and final-image inspection

criteria.task: Build a hosted sanitized oracle/harness around an uninstrumented restricted target archive, then a separately instrumented diagnostic build. Label each receipt's scope and prevent diagnostic support from entering the production manifest.

ordinary_observation.claim: Sanitized host harness and separately instrumented reference have distinct production archive identities

transfer_observation.claim: Original fail-stop add-overflow handler executes in no-library image with explicit narrow ABI

criteria.task: Complete copy, move, set and unsigned-byte lexicographic compare from permitted byte loads/stores. Declare copy nonoverlap, move snapshot semantics, compare sign-only result and zero-count policy; preserve original destination on any explicitly checked admission failure.

ordinary_observation.claim: Copy/move/set/unsigned compare execute against snapshot/sign oracle

transfer_observation.claim: Same-arena offset admission replaces unrelated-pointer relational ordering

criteria.task: Enumerate all valid src,dst,length triples in an original16-byte arena, including identity, both overlaps, zero and exact ends; compare against a snapshot oracle and guard bytes. Analyze separate-object pointer-order assumptions explicitly.

ordinary_observation.claim: All1785 valid16-byte arena triples preserve snapshot and guards

transfer_observation.claim: Separately allocated objects exercise declared flat-address adapter; portable contract remains offsets

criteria.task: Compile the local byte loops at O0/O2/Os/LTO and inspect object and final calls for unintended self-recursion or external memory helpers. Supply an intentionally recursive-provider negative artifact without executing unbounded recursion.

ordinary_observation.claim: GCC/Clang O0/O2/Os final direct-call graph rejects original recursive provider before execution

transfer_observation.claim: Changed compiler and optimization require separate object/final inspections; historical receipt grants no new profile

criteria.task: Differential-test the byte primitives using an independent snapshot/mathematical oracle over all16-byte arena triples and unsigned compare cases {0,127,128,255}. Preserve minimized discrepancies and exact seed/input identities.

ordinary_observation.claim: Independent byte snapshot and all65536 one-byte order pairs discriminate flawed forward/signed implementations

transfer_observation.claim: 153 split-copy cases and compare antisymmetry assessed with nonoverlap preconditions

criteria.task: Run a selected fixed corpus in a no-libc image with caller storage and explicit exit reporting, while keeping host case generation external. Inject only defined admission failures and verify unchanged guarded state.

ordinary_observation.claim: Strict no-library M4 guest executes1785 arena cases and256 division vectors with caller storage

transfer_observation.claim: Two-byte output quotas preserve complete framed result through semihost and standalone UART

criteria.task: Publish a support matrix separating measured x86-64 runs, compile-only foreign profiles, pointer/address-order assumptions and untested interrupt/board contexts. Give each positive claim a source/configuration/artifact receipt.

ordinary_observation.claim: Native x86 executions and Cortex-M4 emulation have separately bound source/image/configuration evidence

transfer_observation.claim: Offset arena removes unrelated-pointer order assumptions; hardware bus timing/interrupt behavior remain unclaimed

criteria.task: Choose a concrete embedded library version and list every required environment service for a tiny formatted-output proposal. Distinguish documented retarget hooks from uninspected implementation dependencies and refuse claims until source/objects are available.

ordinary_observation.claim: Pinned newlib-nano4.6.0.20260123 tiny printf requires seven concrete environment hooks; partial-write and refusal behavior executes in M4 guest

transfer_observation.claim: Caller-owned raw24-byte service uses no stdio/reentrancy/heap hooks; its explicit output and readiness obligations remain

criteria.task: Implement an original adapter with caller-owned24-byte storage, explicit output callback and a heap-extension operation that always returns UNSUPPORTED without changing state. Inject output refusal/short progress and verify exact ownership and status propagation.

ordinary_observation.claim: 24-byte caller-owned output advances only accepted prefixes and rejects unavailable heap without writes

transfer_observation.claim: Aligned64-byte arena exhaustive used/alignment/size matrix rejects overflow/exhaustion without commit

criteria.task: Create separate declared transport backends for host logging, debugger-dependent semihosting and standalone UART/emulator output; identify each dependency and availability. Only run supported local models, with no hardware flashing.

ordinary_observation.claim: Host sink, semihosted reporting and actual MPS2 UART have separate backend dependencies

transfer_observation.claim: Debugger-disabled images contain no BKPT and return UNSUPPORTED before any debugger operation

criteria.task: Build an original startup-state model containing stack bounds, data load/run intervals, BSS range and entry arguments. Validate nonoverlap/extent/alignment before a bounded copy/zero simulation; real exception state remains target-specific.

ordinary_observation.claim: Plan rejects overlap/range/stack alignment before bounded data/BSS writes

transfer_observation.claim: All33 reset cuts are restartable while retained and unrelated RAM bytes survive

criteria.task: Define which owner creates TLS and walks initialization hooks in a custom runtime; provide one original hook that requires a ready service and reject a schedule invoking it too early. Do not borrow hosted TLS implicitly.

ordinary_observation.claim: Ready service precedes one initialization hook per task instance

transfer_observation.claim: Four independent task instances reject stale generation handles, duplicate hooks and generation exhaustion

criteria.task: For the refusing runtime call each unsupported service through its public API and require a distinct error with no writes or acquired resources. Include an initialization-state guard for a service that becomes available later.

ordinary_observation.claim: Unsupported heap remains a visible no-change refusal before and after readiness

transfer_observation.claim: Client retries NOT_READY only after explicit transition and never treats UNSUPPORTED as retryable

criteria.task: Extend the existing audit with original positive, dynamic-dependency, unresolved-helper and statically resolved forbidden-helper artifacts. Parse bounded reports, reject missing/truncated input and bind reports to the exact binary hash.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual dynamic, unresolved and statically resolved negatives exercise different audit layers

transfer_observation.claim: Stripped symbols reject rather than masquerade as empty dependency evidence

criteria.task: Correlate link-map origins with final disassembly for one compiler-emitted helper and one instrumented probe. Identify calls through direct symbols or resolved addresses and explain limits around indirect calls and inlining.

ordinary_observation.claim: Object imports and final map/call origins discriminate a resolved forbidden provider

transfer_observation.claim: LTO/instrumentation need their separately retained final-image/origin evidence; indirect/inlined semantics remain bounded

criteria.task: Run the complete declared dependency audit for GCC/Clang O0/O2 and supported LTO/instrumentation variants, with one forbidden negative control per applicable profile. Distinguish pass, rejected, unavailable and tool-failure outcomes.

ordinary_observation.claim: Each declared audited source/configuration tuple carries its own reports and negative controls

transfer_observation.claim: Changing binary or allowlist invalidates prior receipt; malformed/truncated/tool-failed reports reject
